cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Acknowledge the Disrespect
cards.instruction: Make someone apologize for the disrespect to your position, not merely for what happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your apology should mention interrupting the chair, not just spilling the tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. The trousers hold no office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Chair.' Let's repair the title while we're here.

mechanism: A presides over the wording of an apology until it names disrespect to the office A holds rather than only the spilled tea or personal interruption.
confusable: D03 seeks apology without naming offense; D51 explicitly requires position disrespect, so the title must matter to A corrections.
comparison: A meeting chair corrects personal apology into office recognition; the trainer alternative needs public repair before another drill.
seedUse: The existing D51-a title correction and refusal of trouser-only apology already make S01 superiority the means of pursuing role-specific respect.
